from textblob import TextBlob
import re

def has_call_to_action(text):

    return bool(re.search(r'\b(share|retweet|spread|act now|must|stop them now|join us)\b', text, re.I))

def analyze_post(text):

    polarity = tb.sentiment.polarity  # emotional valence (-1..1)
    subjectivity = tb.sentiment.subjectivity  # 0..1
    cta = has_call_to_action(text)
    length = len(text.split())
    return {
        "text": text,
        "polarity": polarity,
        "subjectivity": subjectivity,
        "call_to_action": cta,
        "length": length
